request: Analyze GSE310858 for PMID 42113967 (Different effects of 3-week disuse on phenotype and gene expression in calf and thigh muscles.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina), human skeletal muscle; proteomics is in the paper but not in this GEO series
final.sample_inclusion: 12 healthy men, biopsies of m. soleus and m. vastus lateralis 14 days before and on day 20 of 21-day -6 degree head-down bed rest (GEO overall design); 48 libraries = 12 subjects x 2 muscles x 2 time points
final.primary_estimand: within-subject change in gene expression after 3-week disuse (bed rest) vs before, separately in calf (soleus) and thigh (vastus lateralis); the paper reports the soleus response is larger. Disuse is the inverse of the exercise/physical-activity axis: the estimand is the effect of removing loading, not of exercise training.
planned_contrasts: Soleus: after vs before bed rest, paired by subject (abstract: transcriptome changes greater in calf; count not stated in abstract)
Vastus lateralis: after vs before bed rest, paired by subject (abstract; count not stated in abstract)
final.paper_method: not stated in abstract; GEO data_processing: HISAT2 alignment to GRCh38, Rsubread exon counts (Ensembl 101)
final.paper_results: abstract: greater transcriptome change in soleus than vastus lateralis; no DEG counts or gene lists in the abstract

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: No full text available; the study map is built from the PubMed abstract (efetch PMID 42113967) and the GEO series summary/overall design. The abstract defines two within-subject disuse responses (calf, thigh) and a between-muscle comparison of their magnitude. No DE method, threshold, or DEG counts are given, so the threshold falls to the workflow default.
paper_reconstruction.locator: PubMed abstract; GEO GSE310858 overall design

checks: series title matches the paper title
48 GSMs = 12 subjects x 2 muscles x 2 time points, consistent with abstract (12 young males, soleus and vastus lateralis)
single supplementary matrix GSE310858_Read_counts.txt.gz with 48 sample columns

ownership.reasoning: The series links the PMID directly and its design matches the abstract.

alignment.reasoning: The deposited column names (<subject>-<time 0/1>-<s/v>_S<n>.sorted.bam) are not in the metadata; prep/rename_columns.py maps each column by name to the GSM with the same individual, time point (0=before, 1=after) and tissue (s=soleus, v=vastus) and fails on any unmatched or duplicate mapping. Alignment then matches GSM ids exactly on the metadata index. time and tissue come from the title ("Sol before 1"); subject from characteristics individual.

final.paper_input: uniquely aligned read counts per gene (GEO data_processing: Rsubread exon counting)

matrix.reasoning: 100% integers, zeros to 3.7M, median 0; data_processing states 'uniquely aligned read counts for genes' from Rsubread featureCounts. Raw counts.

design.subject: subject

candidates.value: pool soleus and vastus with tissue as covariate
candidates.reason_rejected: the paper's estimand is muscle-specific; pooling would assume a common disuse effect
identical to time point (No treatment = before); time is used
the abstract compares the size of the two responses, not a formal interaction test; not run (could be added as exploratory)

design.reasoning: Each subject is biopsied before and after bed rest in both muscles. The two planned contrasts are after vs before within each muscle, blocked by subject. There is no non-bed-rest control group, so the contrast is a pre-post change (time and disuse are not separable). All participants are male (single sex).

covariance.reasoning: Repeated biopsies per subject: subject enters the model as a blocking factor. Age and BMI are subject-level constants and are absorbed by the subject term; no batch column is recorded.

method.reasoning: Raw counts; a paired design with subject as a blocking factor in DESeq2 is the standard route. The paper's method is unknown (abstract only).

final.deviation_note: Abstract gives no threshold; workflow default BH padj < 0.05. Audit rule adds |FC| > 1.25 (log2 0.3219281), a cutoff often used by this group, labelled as audit only.

caveats: Comparison with the paper rests on the abstract only; no paper DEG counts are available.
Estimand is disuse (bed rest), the inverse of the exercise axis, not an exercise intervention.
Pre-post design without a control group: time-related changes cannot be separated from disuse.

study.reasoning: Paper route is reproduced as far as the abstract defines it; qualitative check: soleus should show more DEGs than vastus lateralis.

discrepancies.data: columns use <subject>-<time>-<tissue>_S<n> names not present in GEO metadata

executions.name: Sol_after_vs_before
executions.reasoning: soleus disuse response, paired by subject

executions.name: Vas_after_vs_before
executions.reasoning: vastus lateralis disuse response, paired by subject

enrichment.reasoning: abstract names mitochondrial and translation-regulator changes; GSEA Hallmark on the full ranking
